I am writing to inquire about the possibility of undertaking a clinical internship at King George’s Medical University (KGMU), Lucknow, as an international medical student.

I am currently a seventh-year medical student in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and, as part of my medical training, I am required to complete a 16-month clinical internship in the following four major departments:

General Surgery – 4 months

Obstetrics and Gynecology – 4 months

Internal Medicine – 4 months

Pediatrics – 4 months

I am considering KGMU as a potential institution for this clinical training and would therefore be grateful if you could provide me with detailed information regarding the possibility and requirements for an international medical student to undertake such an internship at your institution.

In particular, I would appreciate clarification on the following points:

Eligibility

Does KGMU accept international medical students from the Democratic Republic of the Congo for clinical internships?

Would a seventh-year medical student be eligible to undertake the proposed clinical rotations?

Duration and departments

Is it possible to undertake a continuous 16-month clinical internship at KGMU?

Would it be possible to complete the four rotations listed above, with four months in each department?

If the exact proposed duration or rotation structure is not possible, what alternatives are available?

Application procedure

What is the application procedure for international medical students?

What documents are required for the application?

Is an official letter or recommendation from my university required?

Are academic transcripts, curriculum vitae, passport copy, vaccination records, medical certificates or other documents required?

Fees and financial requirements

What are the tuition, internship, administrative or other applicable fees for international students?

Are the fees charged per month, per department, or for the entire internship?

Are there any additional costs that I should anticipate?

Visa and immigration

What type of Indian visa would be required for this type of clinical internship?

Does KGMU provide an official acceptance/invitation letter to support the visa application?

Clinical activities and supervision

What clinical activities are international medical interns permitted to participate in?

Are they allowed to attend ward rounds, outpatient clinics, operating theatres, emergency services and other clinical activities?

Is clinical supervision provided by KGMU faculty?

Accommodation and practical arrangements

Does KGMU provide accommodation for international students/interns?

If so, what are the accommodation options and approximate costs?

Is there an International Student Office or designated contact person who assists international students with administrative matters?

Availability and starting date

I am hoping to begin my clinical internship on 15 january 2027.

Would it be possible to start the internship around this date?

If not, what would be the earliest available starting date?

I would be very grateful if you could provide me with the relevant regulations, application forms, fee structure, and any official guidelines applicable to international medical students wishing to undertake clinical training at KGMU.

I am prepared to provide any additional documents required and would be grateful for guidance on the next steps of the application process.

Thank you very much for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response.

Yours faithfully,
